record.paper_title: Open problems of the 32nd Workshop on Cycles and Colourings
record.original_question: Does there exist a planar graph G whose list packing number χ⋆ℓ(G) is at least 6, where χ⋆ℓ(G) is the least k such that every k-list-assignment of G admits k pairwise disjoint proper L-colorings?

evidence.quote: Problem 2.6 Is there a planar graph with χ⋆ ℓ(G)≥6?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For a graph $G$ and an assignment $L$ that gives each vertex $v$ a list $L(v)$ of colors, an $L$-coloring is a proper coloring $c$ with $c(v)\in L(v)$ for every $v\in V(G)$. A collection of $L$-colorings $c_1,\dots,c_k$ of $G$ is called an $L$-packing if for every vertex $v$ the colors $c_1(v),\dots,c_k(v)$ are pairwise distinct (equivalently, the colorings are pairwise "disjoint" in the sense that no two assign the same color to the same vertex). A $k$-list-assignment is a list assignment $L$ with $|L(v)|=k$ for all $v$. The list packing number $\chi^\star_\ell(G)$ is defined as the smallest integer $k$ such that for every $k$-list-assignment $L$ of $G$, there exists an $L$-packing consisting of $k$ proper $L$-colorings of $G$.

Question: Does there exist a planar graph $G$ with $\chi^\star_\ell(G)\ge 6$?
artifact.status_search_result: Recent work establishes that every planar graph $G$ satisfies $\chi^\star_\ell(G)\le 8$, with tighter bounds under girth assumptions, but no construction of a planar graph with list packing number at least 6 is known. The existence of such a graph appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: List Packing and Correspondence Packing of Planar Graphs
status_evidence.snippet: χ*_ℓ(G) ≤ 8 for all planar graphs; no planar graph with list packing number ≥ 6 is exhibited.
status_evidence.claim: The best known upper bound for the list packing number of planar graphs is 8, and no example with value ≥ 6 is known.

status_evidence.title: Counting Packings of List-colorings of Graphs
status_evidence.snippet: Discussion of list packing number bounds for planar graphs and subfamilies.
status_evidence.claim: Bounds on the list packing number of planar graphs are an active subject; no lower bound of 6 is established.
